text:
maria: quick q — I have a request_id `req_42a7e3` (and trace id `trace-9f8c`) from a customer debug session. Where do I look in the Console and from CLI to pull the full log lines?

devon: console: Logs -> set time range +- 5m around the request and use query `request_id:\"req_42a7e3\"` (or `trace_id:\"trace-9f8c\"`). use the left filters to narrow service / env. :eyes:

jamie: CLI option: use `redwoodctl logs query` — eg:
```
redwoodctl logs query --filter 'request_id=req_42a7e3' --start '2024-05-17T12:20:00Z' --end '2024-05-17T12:30:00Z' --json
```
That returns raw JSON lines you can pipe to `jq` for fields.

maria: nice — does traces -> logs link still work? i clicked trace and didn't see the link on one of the spans.

devon: traces->logs link exists only if the span recorded `request_id` as a tag. If it's missing, try `redwoodctl traces get --trace-id trace-9f8c --json | jq '.spans[] | select(.tags.request_id)'` to find any span tag.

observability-bot: heads-up — sampling may drop full logs for high-traffic routes. If you can't find lines, check `log_sampling` flagged in the span tags.

jamie: if you have the trace but not the request_id, use this to map any request-id-like tags:
```
redwoodctl traces get --trace-id trace-9f8c --json | jq -r '.spans[] | .tags | to_entries[]? | select(.key|test("request|req_id|request_id")) | "\(.key)=\(.value)"'
```

maria: useful — thanks. Any tips if CLI returns empty?

devon: quick checklist:
- confirm time window (most misses are time range)
- confirm env/service (prod vs staging filter)
- sampling/retention: ask `sre-oncall` to check if ingestion sampling was applied during that window
- check edge logs (edge-service sometimes records request_id as `x-request-id`)

sre-oncall: I looked: between 12:15-12:25 UTC we had 10% log sampling for the route (config key `logs.sampling.route_v2`). I can rehydrate raw request batches from the archived sink for that interval if you need the full payload — ping me the exact request_id(s).

maria: will do, thanks. Also, can someone drop the Console direct link for future reference?

devon: Console quick links:
- Logs search: https://console.redwood.ai/logs?query=request_id%3Areq_42a7e3
- Traces: https://console.redwood.ai/traces?query=trace-9f8c

jamie: saved snippet for future (put this in eng-infra playbook later):
```
# CLI: find logs by request id
redwoodctl logs query --filter 'request_id=<REQ_ID>' --start '<ISO_START>' --end '<ISO_END>' --json | jq -C '.[] | {ts:.timestamp, svc:.service, msg:.message}'

# map trace -> request id
redwoodctl traces get --trace-id <TRACE_ID> --json | jq -r '.spans[] | .tags.request_id? // empty'
```

maria: perfect — I'll try the rehydrate if needed and ping @sre-oncall. :thumbsup:

observability-bot: note: docs updated: https://docs.redwood.ai/observability/logs-traces#find-by-request-id (includes console & CLI examples)

maria: awesome, closing this thread after I confirm.
